format: changes: key -> [before, after, category, judged identifier]; oracles: identifier -> the source algid's identity comes from

categories.classical-now-named: A public-key identifier the old name rules did not know (a classical OID, brainpool, sect*, MODP, curve25519, GOST, bign) now resolves to its quantum-vulnerable identity: qv None -> True, QUANTUM_VULNERABLE (NO_PQ_KEX on a TLS group; DSA on a DSA OID). DA §7 T-B3 must-flip 'brainpool/sect/MODP/curve25519 (None->True, + NO_PQ_KEX on brainpool groups)'; §3.3 oid
categories.pq-now-named: A post-quantum identifier (CSOR/PKIX OID, HSS/LMS/XMSS, composite, Dilithium/Kyber, McEliece, FN-DSA, 'ML DSA 65', rsa3072_dilithium2) now resolves as quantum safe or hybrid: qv -> False, DSA and QUANTUM_VULNERABLE dropped. A key or certificate: any public-key primitive; an SSH or TLS key-exchange slot: a KEM or key agreement only (review 5901836120 m2). DA §7 must-flip 'PQ and XMSS/HSS OIDs (None->False)', 'FN-DSA/"ML DSA 65"/rsa3072_dilithium2 (drop DSA/QV)'; §3.5 token-bounded DSA; OA-CB04-4
categories.tls-pq-group-evidence: A TLS endpoint whose negotiated group algid knows as a post-quantum KEM or key agreement (primitive kem/key-agree): classify.pq_kex_evidence is True, so no NO_PQ_KEX, qv False and posture class hybrid (the :4432 old-node shape, KF-3a). DA §4 classify.py:208/249 and posture.py:42
categories.tls-pq-signature-not-kex: A post-quantum signature (primitive signature: ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, XMSS, a composite signature) in a TLS group slot is no key exchange: it is no PQ key-exchange evidence and gives no verdict, as an unknown group (qv None, not-applicable; no NO_PQ_KEX without pq_hybrid false). Review 5901836120 m1; DA §4 classify.py:208/249
categories.ssh-pq-signature-not-kex: A post-quantum signature (primitive signature) in an SSH kex list is no key exchange: it is judged as an unknown kex method, so a list with no post-quantum KEM keeps SSH_NO_PQ_KEX and qv True. Dev's rule credited any name with a PQ marker (the same defect as review 5901836120 m2, older than algid); DA §4 classify.py SSH kex
categories.gost-r-34.10-signature: GOST R 34.10-2012 keys are elliptic-curve keys (signature, RFC 9215; the same curves key VKO agreement, the TLS gostr34102012_* and IKE GOST3410-2012-* groups), not a symmetric cipher: the managed key leaves the symmetric path, qv False -> True. DA §4 node_keys H-3
categories.placeholder-group: s_client's '<NULL>' / '(NONE)' / 'Unknown OID' group is no group: the protocol evidence decides (qv True) instead of an unknown group (qv None). DA §3.5 sentinels, FP-6
categories.ike-mlkem-group: An IKE policy whose groups include ML-KEM (IKEv2 Transform Type 4 id 35-37, RFC 9370 additional key exchange) by name or 'group N': no IKE_NO_PQ, qv False. DA §4 node_net H-8
categories.pca-raw-identifier: An AWS Private CA row stored before CB-04 (algorithm ECDSA, key_alg ML_DSA_*) is judged by its raw post-quantum identifier: QUANTUM_VULNERABLE dropped. DA §4 classify.py:418, §6 ST-2
categories.ssh-legacy-name-rules: CB-13 (PR #111) completes the legacy SSH name rules, which read every offered list: an SSH row whose only change is the one code its name now gets, everything else as before (qv True, SSH_NO_PQ_KEX, posture). cb-13 SPEC RC-6 and §3.3: 'des-cbc'/'des' -> SSH_WEAK_CIPHER, 'idea-cbc' -> SSH_WEAK_CIPHER, 'rsa1024-sha1' -> SSH_DH_SHA1, x509v3-sign-dss -> SSH_DSS, ssh-rsa-cert-v01 / x509v3-sign-rsa -> SSH_RSA_SHA1. The GSS-API methods get the code of their non-GSS twin (RFC 4462 §2: gss-group1-sha1-* is Oakley group 2 with SHA-1 = diffie-hellman-group1-sha1 -> SSH_DH_GROUP1; gss-group14-sha1-* and gss-gex-sha1-* = group14 / group exchange with SHA-1 -> SSH_DH_SHA1), PR #111 AC-3 'GSS' and its test_legacy_algorithms_are_flagged cases
categories.cb18-hybrid-identified-component: Hybrid on purpose: a hybrid or composite identifier (composite ML-DSA certificates and keys, SSH ML-KEM/sntrup hybrid kex) whose post-quantum component algid names by a table row, or an IKE policy with an identified ML-KEM group next to a classical group (RFC 9370): quantum-safe -> hybrid. #109 release note 'show Quantum-safe until CB-18'; CB-18 EC-1, OA-CB04-1
categories.cb18-pq-component-unidentified: A post-quantum identifier algid matched only by a marker or an arc prefix (no components, no table row: CRYSTALS-Kyber, Entrust arcs, rsa3072_dilithium2) is never counted as hybrid or safe: -> unknown. CB-18 EC-1 ('an unknown OID is never counted as safe')
categories.cb18-unread-is-unknown: No verdict (qv None) on a certificate or key whose algorithm identifier algid does not know, or on a TLS endpoint whose key exchange was not read (no group, or a group that is no key exchange): unknown, never not-applicable. CB-18 N8/KF-10, SPEC §3.3, FP-6
